    Troubleshooting

    FMOD Plus components are missing

    1. Open FMOD > FMOD Plus > Setup.
    2. Confirm that com.firelight.fmod-for-unity is installed and its converted package version is in [2.2.0,3.0.0).
    3. Resolve the first Console error and allow Unity to recompile.

    The Setup window can remain available even when Runtime and Editor components are disabled because its bootstrap assembly does not reference FMOD.

    FMOD is installed under Assets

    Use Move FMOD to Packages in Setup. Review the preflight result before confirming. Do not manually regenerate FMOD.meta; its GUID must move with the integration.

    Banks or native plugins are missing

    Configure generated bank paths through the official FMOD settings. If platform native binaries are missing, use FMOD's Reorganize Plugin Files command when appropriate for that FMOD version.

    A Key does not resolve

    Verify the selected Global category or Local Key List, check that the key is not empty, and confirm the entry still has a valid Event Reference. Reopen the editor after Undo/Redo or asset changes if the displayed selection is stale.
